top_story_title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager authentication bypass (CVE-2026-76504) exploited as a zero-day, now in CISA KEV
top_story_summary: Cisco published an advisory on September 30, 2026 for CVE-2026-76504, a CVSSv3.1 9.8 API authentication bypass in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager. The root cause is improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request (CWE-177): a crafted request slips past an authentication rule that is supposed to restrict a specific API endpoint, and the attacker reaches the API with the privileges of the admin user. No credentials are needed. Cisco PSIRT became aware of exploitation activity in September 2026, after a Cisco TAC support case, and states the vulnerability is being actively exploited in the wild. CISA added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on September 30, 2026 with a remediation due date of October 3, 2026.
top_actions: Inventory every Catalyst SD-WAN Manager instance and its running version; check each against the fixed-release table in Cisco advisory cisco-sa-sdwan-webauth-xr8beuuU. Cisco states there is no workaround, so the upgrade is the remediation.
Remove the Manager's HTTPS and API ports from internet exposure today, before the change window: restrict to a dedicated management VLAN or out-of-band network reachable only from a jump host.
Patch the controller/orchestrator before edge devices and validate certificate trust and config sync after the upgrade.
After upgrading, rotate Manager admin credentials, API tokens and device certificates - unauthenticated admin-level API access predates the patch and is not undone by it.
Diff current device templates, policies and admin user lists against a known-good export; an admin API session can push configuration to every managed edge router.
executive_summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager: CVE-2026-76504, CVSS 9.8 unauthenticated API authentication bypass to admin, exploited in the wild, added to CISA KEV on September 30, 2026 with a due date of October 3, 2026. Fixed releases exist, no workaround.

Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway: CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 exploited as zero-days; KEV due date was September 30, 2026. LevelBlue reports post-exploitation web shells mapped to CSS-like URLs and superuser account creation.
MikroTik RouterOS: CISA warning on a critical pre-authentication flaw leading to remote code execution or denial of service.
WatchGuard Fireware OS: 15 fixes including a critical code injection bug across firewall and VPN appliances.
Cisco advance notification: security-hardening advisories land October 7, 2026 for APIC, Meraki, NX-OS on MDS 9000 and Nexus 3000/7000/9000, and UCS Fabric Interconnects - plan the window now.

Two internet-facing control points are under confirmed attack at once. Sequence SD-WAN Manager and NetScaler ahead of routine patching, and treat exposed instances as suspect rather than merely vulnerable.
key_actions: **Cisco** — Confirm the running Manager version against the fixed-release table in the Cisco advisory and schedule the upgrade immediately - there is no workaround, so no mitigation substitutes for it.
**Cisco** — Take Manager HTTPS/API ports off the internet now; restrict management access to a dedicated management VLAN or out-of-band network, reachable only via a jump host.
**Cisco** — Treat the KEV due date of October 3, 2026 as the deadline; record patched, mitigated or discontinued against every Manager instance in the change record.

**Cisco** — Apply the Cisco fixed release per the advisory; where a maintenance window cannot be found in time, remove internet exposure of the management interface as an interim risk reduction and document it.
**Citrix** — Patch to the Citrix fixed build for your release stream - take the version from the Citrix advisory, not from news coverage.
**Citrix** — Terminate all active sessions and revoke session tokens after the upgrade; assume stolen session cookies survive patching.
**Cisco** — Use advisory cisco-sa-sdwan-webauth-xr8beuuU as the single source for the fixed release; do not take version numbers from secondary coverage.
**Cisco** — Upgrade every Manager instance; in clustered deployments follow Cisco's documented upgrade order and verify cluster health afterwards.

headlines.title: Critical Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager API authentication bypass exploited in the wild (CVE-2026-76504)
headlines.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager has a CVSS 9.8 API authentication bypass, CVE-2026-76504, under active exploitation; a crafted HTTP request grants admin-level API access with no credentials.

headlines.title: CISA Adds Exploited Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Auth Bypass to KEV
headlines.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-76504 in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager to the KEV catalog after confirmed exploitation, with a federal remediation deadline of October 3, 2026.

headlines.title: Threat Brief: NetScaler Zero Days CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 Exploited in the Wild (Updated September 30)
headlines.summary: Two NetScaler ADC and Gateway zero-days, CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772, are being exploited in the wild for arbitrary command execution and remote code execution.

headlines.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager API Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
headlines.summary: Cisco PSIRT confirms improper URI encoding handling in Catalyst SD-WAN Manager lets an unauthenticated attacker bypass an API authentication rule and act as admin; no workaround exists.

headlines.title: Citrix NetScaler Post-Exploitation Payload Creates Superuser, Maps Web Shell to CSS-Like URLs
headlines.summary: Attackers exploiting the NetScaler pre-auth command injection are creating superuser accounts and hiding web shells behind CSS-like URLs while stealing appliance configuration.

headlines.title: Cisco Warns of Attackers Exploiting Critical Authentication Bypass in SD-WAN Manager
headlines.summary: Cisco's September 30 advisory says attackers are already abusing a zero-day in Catalyst SD-WAN Manager to reach the management API as admin; fixed releases exist and no workaround does.
